structured.answer: I'd lean to an S&P 500 tracking track, probably Clal's "עוקב מדד s&p 500" because it had the lowest fee of the S&P ones I saw (0.47%) and about the same ~13% 3-year return. But I'm not sure and wouldn't move anything today: first I'd need to find out which company my pension is with.

findings.what: 182 rows with no recommendation or shortlist; a beginner wants to give up
Fees only shown as small percentages with two kinds of fee, nothing in shekels
Big recent returns (22%, 28%) stand out most and pull you toward the riskiest tracks
Exposure numbers above 100% look like a mistake
Circle charts with no labels next to them, so you have to guess the colours
Many unexplained abbreviations and numbers next to the track names
Nothing tells you what to do next or how to switch track
